events.title: C2C Festival, Turin
events.note: C2C, Turin’s festival of avant-pop and electronic music, is on for its 25th edition. Here are the city’s community radio and the artists from the lineup you can hear on Sintonia.

shows.title: Palettes w/ KMRU
shows.why: KMRU, on the C2C lineup, presents his monthly show of ambient and experimental sounds.

events.also: Smerz, Crystallmess, The Avalanches, Theo Parrish, Gyrofield and Chuquimamani-Condori, all on the lineup, also host their own shows on NTS.
